justified_differences: apply_failed terminal phase is the shadow-mode artifact of NullDispatcher rejection; a real dispatcher applies celtic (explicit_applications_only).

justified_differences: intentional supersession: same-profile resume runs no desktop work under the controller (epic acceptance 5, dc-xty), while ng always reloads.
same_profile_suspend_resume.reconciliation: shadow emitted zero plan/prepare/apply intent for the unchanged profile; ng unconditionally reloaded celtic+Samsung-Odyssey-G75F.

samsung_broken_edid_beyond_30_seconds.reconciliation: 407s observation span with exactly one WOULD_PREPARE and no duplicate application while readiness settled; ng reloaded celtic+Samsung-Odyssey-G75F once. Policies agree. Captured on the post-dc-czj reducer, demonstrating health-tick settling live.

samsung_plug.reconciliation: shadow admitted RequestPlan then PrepareDesktop (WOULD_PREPARE x2 after a mid-window DRM hint superseded the first plan) for celtic+Samsung-Odyssey-G75F; ng reloaded the same profile with postswitch deferred. Policies agree.

provenance_classes.live: Sanitized projection of bounded production audit/status evidence observed with the fixed parser running.
provenance_classes.retained_raw_derived: Sanitized excerpt or fixture derived deterministically from retained raw observer/journal evidence; useful as an input but not a live shadow transition.
provenance_classes.synthetic_policy: Deterministic scenario/reducer replay. It is regression coverage, not production audit and not live acceptance.
